Name: Simple Tools Style
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Tool Styles[/size][/b]
Simple Tool Styles gives Stardew Valley's tools a fresh visual look while keeping their original gameplay completely unchanged.
The mod replaces the appearance of supported tools with custom pixel-art designs made to fit naturally with Stardew Valley's style.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Custom artwork for vanilla tools[/*]
[*]Matching visual progression for upgraded tools[/*]
[*]Designed to remain clear and readable in the inventory and hotbar[/*]
[*]Works with the normal tool upgrade system[/*]
[*]Visual-only — no gameplay or balance changes[/*]
[*]Made to pair nicely with Simple Tool Belt, but does not require it[/*]
[/list][heading]Supported Tools[/heading]
[list]
[*]Axe[/*]
[*]Pickaxe[/*]
[*]Hoe[/*]
[*]Watering Can[/*]
[*]Scythe[/*]
[*]Milk Pail[/*]
[*]Shears[/*]
[*]Sword[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and any required dependencies listed in the Files section.[/*]
[*]Download Simple Tool Styles.[/*]
[*]Extract it into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Notes[/heading]
This mod only changes tool visuals. Tool stats, upgrade costs, effects, enchantments and normal Stardew behavior are untouched.

Manifest.Description: Six tool artwork collections, original artwork option and a GMCM settings hotkey.
